description: This is a first course on algebraic topology. The goal of this course is to develop the theory of the fundamental group and covering spaces, as well as the topological classification of two-dimensional manifolds. Main topics include fundamental groups, separation theorems in the plane, Seifert-van Kampen theorem, classification of surfaces, covering spaces and deck transformations, and applications to group theory if time permits.
